items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: It was with Hines and Dickerson, I guess.

ctx.x: Down toward Buras. Down that way. That's down that way. Yeah. So I told him, I said, well, yeah, sure. I'll give you a fare. Went to the station. Went to the station. He got his ticket and everything. And I gave him two extra dollars. Because I was planning on going to Chicago anyway. You know? Yeah. So I said, well, before I could go to Chicago, I'm going to, you know, straighten things out where I want to live at. In Chicago. So that's the break I had. So I went to Chicago. Over to Jolly. I mean, I went on to…
It was with Hines and Dickerson, I guess.

That's right. And then Paul Barbrae was on drums. And Russell's on piano. Russell. Yeah, Lou Russell. I just remember how many they had. They had a big band. Was George Field in Chicago then? George Field, that's right.
